purpose: Teach: 辻/ぃ/にゃ/かぁ/るる/之/燭/頁

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、辻のお地蔵さんに手合わせてたな
lines.en: Riku — I saw you praying at that Jizo statue on the corner.
lines.style: Pointed, amused observation. Quick rhythm, almost teasing. Eyes catching his. Slight smile playing at the corner of her mouth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、「うれしぃ」って語尾の小さぃ「ぃ」気にしてたな、桜
lines.en: You were the one fixating on that little small 'i' in 'ureshii', Sakura.
lines.style: Gentle deflection. Low, almost conversational. A small smile underneath — he's been noticing her too. Not defensive, just turning it back.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ノラ猫に「にゃ」って話しかけてたな
lines.en: Riku — you were literally talking to that stray cat with 'nya'.
lines.style: Building momentum now. More animated than before. Riding the rhythm of catching him. Voice light, delighted.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト返却で「そっかぁ」ってつぶやいたな、桜
lines.en: You muttered 'sokkaa' when you got your test back, Sakura.
lines.style: Steady, remembering. Not triumphant — just matter-of-fact. The tone of someone who listens more than he lets on.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、音楽の授業で「らるるれろ」じゃなくて「るるる」って歌ってたな
lines.en: Riku — in music class you were singing 'ruru' instead of the actual syllables.
lines.style: Peak playfulness. Faster now, almost breathless with amusement. Voice warm, not mean. She's enjoying this.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、書道で「之」をきれいに書けてたな、桜
lines.en: You actually wrote that kanji beautifully in calligraphy, Sakura.
lines.style: Shift to genuine. Quieter. Not praise-voice, but honest recognition. A beat of sincerity breaking through the game.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、林間学校でキャンプの燭、つまりキャンドル持ってたな
lines.en: Riku — you were the one holding the candle at camp during the school trip.
lines.style: Softer than before. Wondering. Less teasing, more noticing. Like she's finding something tender in the memory.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、教科書の二十頁、つまり20ページの問題解いてたな、桜
lines.en: You solved all those problems on page twenty of the textbook, Sakura.
lines.style: Gentle, close. Like he's speaking to her from near. A little softer, a little longer on the final syllable. Not quite looking away.
